title: Imported items get SRD values
summary: Equipment imported from a character sheet now takes its value from the SRD (via Open5e) instead of arriving at zero.
items: Unpriced items on an imported sheet are matched against the SRD 5.1 and 5.2 equipment and magic items, preferring the sheet's edition; the match works offline.
Magic items without a listed price use the SRD 5.2.1 value for their rarity, halved for potions, scrolls and ammunition.
The import review lists each value it found and every item without a match; values you already entered are kept.
Character sheets now show each item's value, and Fill missing values from the SRD prices items imported before this update.
